==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use Dodge both in and out of combat as a speed boost. While under its effects, they will not attack if they are wielding a melee weapon. They will, however, attack if they are wielding a ranged weapon.

== Notes ==
{{speed|5|11|33|30}}
* "Projectiles" means [[ranged attack]]s from weapons, not [[projectile spell]]s.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] seems to be modeled after the [[wikipedia:Heisman Trophy|Heisman Trophy]], an award for outstanding collegiate football players.
